title: Shadow Dance
style_lock: Magnific modern pop art — thick black outlines, Ben-Day dots, flat saturated color. Consistent for ALL 28 scenes. Luis Royo fantasy underlying tone. Cyberpunk/futuristic emo world. Hero photo = likeness reference only.
story: She lets it fall — dancing with her neon shadow through a pop-art cyberpunk city until shadow and self share one beat.
